picks.title: Jesus Defines a Christian
picks.summary: One of the greatest misunderstandings in the church today is what it actually means to be a Christian. Is becoming a Christian simply asking Jesus into your heart or getting baptized? What does JESUS say it means to follow Him? Today we look at what the Bible says about true faith and how we know whether our faith is genuine. Romans 12 shows us that true faith doesn’t stop with a decision—it leads to a life of total surrender to God.
picks.reason: Clarifies what Jesus defines as true Christian faith and life of surrender.

picks.title: No More Games - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E4
picks.summary:
Following Jesus isn’t a negotiation. We don’t get to set the terms, hold onto certain parts of our lives or simply swap a few habits. Jesus came for our hearts, and His invitation is to surrender everything.

picks.showTitle: BIG Life Devotional | Daily Devotional for Women
picks.title: 2190 Parable of the Lost Son-1
picks.summary: This is the final of the trilogy of stories Jesus tells to explain the worth of a single soul to God. We had the Parable of the Lost Sheep where the shepherd leaves the 99 to find the 1 who has been lost. We had the Parable of the Lost Coin of the woman who has 10 coins, but when she loses 1 she looks relentlessly until it’s found. Notice the numbers – 1 out of 99 – 1 out of 10 – and now Jesus takes it down to even a more personal and direct number – 1 out of 2 with the Parable of the Lost Son. This is the story we often refer to as the Prodigal son, depending on the translation you’re reading
picks.reason: Devotional on the Parable of the Lost Son emphasizing God's pursuit of the lost.
